shell_commands:
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(tools): fix Ajv import and test linting issues

Fix TypeScript error by importing Ajv as named export instead of default.
Combine multiple expects into single assertion to satisfy re-lint/max-expects.
Remove console.log from test.
Link unit test to spec statement for re-lint/require-spec-link.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
timeout 300 npm test -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -A 50 "returns schema validation rejection"
npm run eslint -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "returns schema validation|re-lint"
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && npm run eslint -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "returns schema validation|error|warning" | head -5
npm run typecheck 2>&1 && echo "✓ typecheck passed"
npm run eslint -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md 2>&1 && echo "✓ eslint passed"

git add src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): validate schema rejection returned as tool_result

Add unit test in chatOrchestrator.test.ts that validates a tool call with 
invalid input according to schema doesn't crash the orchestrator and allows 
the model to retry with corrected input. Link test to spec statement 
for traceability.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git push origin HEAD && git status
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main 2>&1 | head -5
